title: The fish under the surface at a spot (D139): how a spot's pool is stocked and kept, and what the wizard's looks show

add.description: A pool is stocked with 2d6 plus this many fish.

colourAt.description: From this many looks, Look Underwater shows a fish in its colours; before, as a shadow.

nameAt.description: From this many looks, the player knows what the fish is: the log names it and the journal lists it.

shadows.description: How many of the pool's fish show as shadows under the surface, at most.

leave.description: With each new part of the day, the chance (%) that a wild fish leaves when the moment meets none of its preferences; halved (the preference factor) for each one met, and once more while it spawns.

school.description: How many fish a school feature brings into the pool (the bench only: schools form by themselves, D157).

show.description: The chance (%) that a pool fish shows as a shadow from the bank, by the depth it swims at (D136).

dim.description: At night and in the rain, the share (%) of those chances that is left.

aim.description: How far from a shadow, in scene pixels across and up, a cast still lands on it.

eat.description: With each new part of the day, the chance (%) per point of the water's temperature that a predator with a wild fish under half its length there takes one (D157).

fromPool.description: Of the fish that bite, the share (%) that are the pool's own when it is at its number; less as it thins, a passer-by from the spot's table filling the gap (D157).

spawnCrowd.description: A full pool still draws a spawning kind until it holds this many times its number.

shoal.description: This many of a shoaling kind in a pool swim as a school.

shoalGap.description: How far apart, in scene pixels across and up, the fish of a school keep.

drift.description: How many scene pixels a pool fish may drift with each cast, at most; half as much up and down.
